jobs.title: Fellowship Program Coordinator – Anesthesiology
jobs.description:
**Employment Duration:** 3 months

**Work Schedule:** The standard work schedule is 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. or 9:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m., with flexibility in scheduling on most days. **Wednesdays have a required schedule of 6:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m. onsite at Mission Bay to provide conference support.**

The Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care is seeking a Fellowship Program Coordinator to support the administration and operations of its medical fellowship education programs.

The Fellowship Program Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support for ACGME-accredited and non-ACGME fellowship programs, including Pain Medicine, Pediatric Anesthesia, and Obstetric Anesthesia. Working with fellowship program leadership, faculty, fellows, and Graduate Medical Education stakeholders, the coordinator supports scheduling, educational activities, recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, accreditation and compliance, evaluations, reporting, and maintenance of program records.

The position also coordinates departmental Grand Rounds and M&M conferences, fellowship and residency didactic activities, and fellowship moonlighting operations.

This is a full-time, hybrid position requiring four days onsite and one day offsite. Work locations include Parnassus, Mission Bay, and Mt. Zion. The schedule varies based on program needs, and the position must be available to begin work at 6:30 a.m. on Wednesdays to provide onsite setup and operational support for departmental Grand Rounds.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Fellowship Program Administration & Educational Coordination**

* Provide administrative and operational support to Program Directors and Associate Program Directors for Obstetric Anesthesia, Pain Medicine, and Pediatric Anesthesia fellowship programs.
* Assist in creating and maintaining annual fellowship rotation and call schedules.
* At the direction of program faculty and leadership, create program and curricular evaluation documentation, including evaluation tools, strategies, and timelines.
* Generate regular evaluation reports and maintain evaluations and work-hour information in MedHub.
* Coordinate logistics for program activities, including recruitment, orientation, graduation, conferences, simulation activities, and other educational or assessment activities.
* Coordinate special events, lectures, journal clubs, and conferences, including conference room reservations and food orders.
* Coordinate speakers for journal clubs and conferences.
Assist with committee meetings, including Program Evaluation Committee and Clinical Competency Committee meetings, as applicable.  

**Grand Rounds & Didactic Program Coordination**

* Coordinate and provide operational support for the Department of Anesthesia and Perioperative Care's weekly Grand Rounds and M&M conferences.
* Provide onsite setup and program support beginning at 6:30 a.m. on Wednesdays.
* Coordinate didactic sessions and lecture series for fellowship and residency education in Pain Medicine, Pediatric Anesthesia, and Obstetric Anesthesia.
* Coordinate scheduling, faculty and speakers, room and virtual meeting setup, and program communications.
* Track attendance and completion requirements.
Maintain educational calendars and related program documentation.  

**Accreditation & Regulatory Compliance**

* Assist Program Directors with preparation for Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) site visits and internal reviews.
* Gather and enter information requested by Program Directors for the annual ACGME Accreditation Data System (ADS) update.
* Track completion of annual ACGME program surveys by fellows and faculty.
Maintain program records and support compliance with accreditation standards and other regulatory requirements.  

**Fellowship Recruitment, Appointments & Onboarding**

* Perform fellowship match responsibilities through ERAS and SF Match.
* Coordinate fellowship interviews, including faculty scheduling, conference room reservations, tours, and transportation.
* Maintain professional and informative communication with prospective candidates regarding interview schedules and program-related questions.
* Correspond with newly matched fellows regarding appointments and hospital appointment processes.
* Monitor credentialing requirements to help ensure fellows are appropriately credentialed before beginning rotations.
* Assist with operational components related to learner employment, including HR onboarding, appointment paperwork, credentialing, training grants, payroll and FTE tracking, benefits and leave advising, and Medicare reimbursement reporting.
Assist fellows completing their programs with separation and offboarding paperwork.  

**Non-ACGME Fellowship Program Support**

* Support Program Directors for non-ACGME fellowship programs.
* Serve as a point of contact for prospective candidates, current health professions education learners, and other program stakeholders.
* Respond to questions, disseminate program information, and assist learners with program-related issues.
* Assist with applicable accreditation processes.
Assist fellows with separation paperwork.  

**Fellowship Moonlighting Coordination**

* Ensure fellows participating in moonlighting activities have appropriate medical staff privileges.
* Coordinate with fellowship coordination staff regarding fellow schedules.
* Monitor compliance with UCSF work-hour policies.
Process payments associated with fellowship moonlighting activities.  

**Administrative Operations & Program Reporting**

* Support administrative, financial, and other program operations in accordance with accreditation standards and regulatory requirements.
* Prepare reports and conduct necessary follow-up.
* Monitor trainee schedules to support compliance with curriculum standards.
* Manage, monitor, and document clinical fellowship and faculty evaluation processes.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator/Youth Mentor
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives!**

We're looking for a **Program Coordinator** for the **San Jose, CA area!**

**Specifics:**

* **Official Job Title:** Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, 10 hours per week
* **Job Location:** San Jose, CA
* **Rate of Pay**: $21.00 per hour

**Our Philosophy**

**LifeSTEPS** is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services. The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for “**S**kills **T**raining and **E**ducational **P**rograms” and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by LifeSTEPS will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**About us**

LifeSTEPS, is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit charitable organization. It was founded in 1996 and currently has over 440 partnered affordable housing properties all over the state of California. We serve several regions from Sacramento, Bay Area, South Bay, Central Valley, LA County and Inland Pacific regions. We work with 115,000 residents all over the state and we’re on a mission to provide effective educational and supportive services to maximize the strengths of individuals and build resilient communities.

**Our Benefits**

In addition to meeting your passion for making a difference in the lives of those we serve, all employees will receive the following benefits:

* Competitive pay based on skill and experience
* Paid Holidays
* Paid Sick Leave
* Employee Assistance Program
* LifeSTEPS Perks Program

Benefit eligible employees working 30 hours per week or more will also receive:

* Medical, Dental Vision, and Life Insurance
* 401(k) plan
* Identity Theft Program
* Pet Insurance
* Paid Time Off

**About the Position**

The **Program Coordinator,** under the direction of the Regional Director of Social Services, is expected to design, implement, and coordinate activities and programs within assigned affordable housing complexes. This position works closely with the Director of Social Services (DSS) to provide the highest quality of service to the residents served by LifeSTEPS.

**Core Duties** **Program Coordinator**

* Empower children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing after-school education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go after school to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Education and/or Experience and/or License Certification:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing services.
* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, or related field preferred.
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support individuals and families so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? Apply today!!!

**Please Note**

***LifeSTEPS values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. Diversity at LifeSTEPS means fostering a workplace in which individual differences are recognized, appreciated, respected, and responded to in ways that fully develop and utilize each person's talents and strengths. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, disability, age or covered veteran status. Please provide us with notice if you will require accommodations during the interview process***

**Abode Services**, one of the largest and effective nonprofits working to end homelessness in the Bay Area, is seeking a Program Coordinator I for our program in San Jose, CA. ***\* Please be advise the shift for this position is: Tuesday- Friday 12:00 PM-8:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM-5:00 PM***

**About Abode:**

At **Abode**, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.

**Our Values:**

We start with dignity, take smart risks, be transparent, solve for today and tomorrow, and spark each other’s strengths in everything we do!

**The Diverse Culture:**

We believe that we make better decisions and provide quality services when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. People of color make up nearly 70% of our workforce and we strive to recruit and retain employees from all backgrounds.

**About The Role**:

The Program Coordinator will supervise the provision of services to program participants in the County, through direct staff supervision of staff.

**How You Make An Impact**: :

* Supervise the provision of housing for programs in the County through direct supervision of staff.
* Improve housing program skills through supervision, coaching, and training of staff. Address performance issues, as necessary.
* Provide support to the team when dealing with complex participant and/or landlord issues, which may include leading case conferencing meetings, connecting staff with other community resources for support, and providing direct services to clients/landlords.
* Provide housing location services for clients and ensure collaboration with appropriate Abode staff to ensure subsidy payments.
* Complete initial and annual HQS inspections accurately and on time.
* Maintain relationships with property owners and manage housing stock. This will mean developing new landlord contacts, as well as maintaining current units.
* Communicate closely and frequently with all members of the housing and services team to improve systems, solve problems, share resources, and coordinate work.
* Ensuring timely completion of HMIS annual updates, and quarterly/yearly income assessments as needed.
* Maintain housing files and support Compliance Specialists to ensure program compliance.
* Attends staff meetings and other agency functions as needed. Oversee audits and monthly program reports as needed.
* Maintain unit/participant information in WMAT. Run rent reports and ensure property owner payments.
* Ensure accuracy of participant rent calculations and upload to WMAT/participant files.
* Work with the manager/finance team to ensure appropriate budget maintenance. Review monthly MER reports.
* Maintain knowledge of HUD regulations/prepare files for monthly audits with the County.
* Other duties as assigned.

**How You Meet Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field and equivalent experience.
* 2 years of field experience working with people with co-occurring disorders and/or who are homeless.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of valid California Driver's License and current auto insurance, along with a clean DMV record, is required.
* Driving and transportation of participants when required.
* Flexible schedule to work evening and weekend hours as needed.

COMPETENCIES:

* Professional experience in the human services, social work, psychology, or related field and demonstrated experience in rental housing programs for low income, special needs individuals and families.
* Ability to work within a housing first philosophy and Harm Reduction model and lead others to work with these models.
* Basic knowledge and understanding of applicable federal, state, and local laws.
* Excellent verbal & written communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work well independently and collaboratively with teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, systems, and platforms.
* Ability to learn and use required mobile devices and business-related applications.
* Ability to build supportive and respectful working relationships with transition age youth that instills hope and promotes self-determination using a strengths-based approach.
* Possess an understanding of and practice cultural sensitivity through open dialogue and self-exploration with diverse groups, while providing direct services.
* Ability to effectively intervene in crisis situations and make sound decisions in difficult situations with participants.
* Outstanding communication skills and high degree of emotional intelligence, cultural humility, with a proven track record to build and maintain effective relationships with a wide variety of internal and external contacts.

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

jobs.title: Clinical Case Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

**Clinical Case Manager**

**Adult Full Service Partnership (FSP)**

**Adult Division**

**Agency Overview**

Felton Institute responds to the needs of our community by providing innovative, evidence-informed social services that transform lives. Our organization offers 60+ programs that address mental health, the unhoused, early care and education, those impacted by the justice system, transitional age youth, as well as aging adults. Our programs combine the latest scientific research with cultural sensitivity and a deep commitment to supporting and reflecting the communities we serve. Felton offers a dynamic, challenging, and supportive work environment where we encourage the use of professional development, that staff can utilize throughout their career.

**Program Description**

Serving adults living with serious mental illness, the Adult FSP program provides an extensive array of recovery-oriented, age-appropriate services and supports, including linkage to housing and basic needs, physical health care, benefits assistance, and employment services, and integrated mental health and substance abuse treatment services. The programs follow an assertive community treatment model, providing medication management, individual and group therapy, individual and group rehabilitation skills training, crisis intervention, and case management. The programs consist of multi-disciplinary teams of a psychiatrist(s), nurse practitioner(s), licensed vocational nurse(s), a program director, clinical case managers, case managers, a client support specialist, and an administrative manager. Services are provided to clients both in the office and in the field.

**Job Description**

The Clinical Case Manager meets with and evaluates the needs of clients and develops a treatment plan in collaboration with the client. The Clinical Case Manager provides specialized mental health services, including therapy, rehabilitative skills training, crisis intervention, and case management. The Clinical Case Manager provides a safe and supportive environment for the client and their support system and adheres to laws regarding confidentiality and mandated reporting. Services are provided both in the field (hospital, client’s home, courthouse, doctor’s office, etc.) and in the office. The Clinical Case Manager must maintain accurate detailed records in our electronic health record system. The caseload for each CCM is about 17 clients.

**Specific Responsibilities**

* Provide individual and group therapy, individual and group rehabilitative skills training, case management, and crisis intervention services to our clients.
* Link clients to basic needs, including income, housing, job training, insurance, and/or nutrition, among other resources.
* Assist clients in creating and maintaining stability in the community by offering at least weekly appointments.
* Collaborate with community partners in housing, finance, basic needs, and medical services.
* Provide independent living skills education to clients in the office and in their home.
* Responsible for an average of 60-66 hours of direct services per month.
* Maintain timely documentation of services provided that meet Medi-Cal standards.
* Provide officer-of-the-day responsibilities to TAY and Adult Mental Health Program clients.
* Hold a 24-hour crisis line (2-week rotations among staff).

**Minimum Requirements andQualifications**

* Master’s degree in Social Work, Psychology or related fields of study required.
* Must have experience in case management and mental health services with severely mentally ill, dually diagnosed adults.
* Comprehensive knowledge of mental health and substance abuse counseling, assessment, and crisis intervention skills.
* Must be, or have the potential to be, registered with the BBS.
* Willingness to work from a strength-based, harm reduction, client-centered model with an emphasis on evidence-based practices.
* Ability to work cooperatively on a multi-disciplinary team, and to work with people of various ethnic and cultural backgrounds.
* Strong organizational, communication, documentation, time management, and interpersonal skills.

**Additional Information:**

Reports to: Program Director of Adult Intensive Case Management

Job Type: Full Time

Work Schedule: Onsite or in the community Mon-Fri 9am-5pm

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary Range: $105,000 - $113,000 annually (DOE)

Benefits (subject to election and eligibility): Fully-Paid Medical and Dental Plans; Health Reimbursement Card, Paid Time Off (personal, vacation, and sick time), 403B with company match.

**Job Summary:**

The California Collaborative for Public Health Research (CPR3) advances public health through research, partnerships, and evidence-informed strategies that strengthen collaboration among academic institutions, public health agencies, healthcare organizations, and community partners. CPR3 supports initiatives that translate research into practice and improve the health and well-being of California communities.

The Public Health for All Californians Together (PHACT) Coalition, co-led by the California Department of Public Health, Covered California, and CPR3, is a statewide network of more than 1,400 members representing over 400 organizations committed to strengthening evidence-based public health policy, service delivery, and culturally responsive communication. While the Coalition's current priorities include immunization policy, vaccine access, coverage, and culturally responsive communication, its broader mission is to strengthen public health infrastructure, safeguard scientific integrity, and promote equitable access to life-saving preventive services for all Californians.

The CPR3 Project Manager will provide day-to-day operations support, including project management, communications, stakeholder engagement, and strategic coordination for the PHACT Coalition and other CPR3 initiatives. Reporting to the CPR3 Director of Operations and Strategy, the incumbent will provide program management, knowledge management, and program and policy analysis support to the PHACT Coalition Community Partnerships Working Group. The incumbent will lead planning and execution of bi-monthly coalition meetings, including agenda development, speaker coordination, meeting logistics, preparation of meeting materials, facilitation, and post-meeting follow-up.

In collaboration with Coalition leadership, the incumbent will develop and implement communications strategies that keep members informed of emerging public health issues, promote engagement across the statewide network, and increase coalition visibility. Responsibilities include developing newsletters and other communications, maintaining coalition communication platforms, supporting dissemination of evidence-based resources, and identifying opportunities to strengthen partner engagement.

The position will also support coalition membership management, stakeholder engagement, donor reporting, and tracking of project milestones and deliverables. The incumbent will build and maintain productive relationships with state and local public health agencies, academic institutions, healthcare organizations, and community-based organizations while contributing to the continuous improvement of coalition operations and workflows.

The successful candidate will demonstrate excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills and contribute to the continued growth and impact of the PHACT Coalition. The ideal candidate will have 2–4 or more years of experience in program management, public health communications, and collaboration with academic institutions, public health agencies, and community-based organizations. Experience supporting multi-sector partnerships and statewide initiatives is highly desirable. An MPH or related graduate degree is preferred but not required.

  

**Department Overview:**

The Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics (DEB), housed within the UCSF School of Medicine, is the largest department of epidemiology in the University of California system. DEB is the epicenter of many of UCSF’s initiatives in population health, data science and informatics, health service research, health equity and artificial intelligence. The DEB has three missions: 1) education, 2) science, and 3) research. Its educational mission is to train students in epidemiologic and biostatistical methods for studying disease etiology and prevention, evaluating tests and treatments, and using evidence-based approaches in clinical practice and population health. The scientific mission of the DEB is to perform outstanding basic, clinical and population health research along a spectrum from molecules to society and to develop tools for the translation of knowledge that will improve clinical practice and population health and ensure optimal use of resources. The clinical mission of the Department is to support the practice of public health and preventive medicine in local, state, national and international health agencies.

* Three or more year of experience working with community-based organizations
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing. 2+ years of experience applying broad communication strategies to execute cross-sectoral initiatives.
* Three or more years of project management experience in healthcare, academia, public health or social service sector

* Demonstrated experience working with partners that represent a broad array of interests

**Preferred:**

* Strong policy analysis techniques and applied research skills
* Master’s Degree in Public Health

jobs.title: Manager, Business Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
### **Position Summary**

The Manager of Business Strategy & Operations will play an important role in shaping and executing Salma Health’s strategic and operational initiatives as the company scales. Working closely with the executive team and function leaders, this person will help operations evolve for the next stage of growth and build the measurement and reporting that move decisions from intuition to data. This position calls for a blend of strategic thinking, operational expertise, and financial acumen to support the company’s growth and impact in the mental health space.

**Location:** Hybrid | San Mateo, CA

**Key Responsibilities**

### **Strategy and Cross-Functional Initiatives**

* Support strategic and operational initiatives from problem definition through implementation and measurement.
* Partner with department and clinical leaders to diagnose where operations need to evolve for the next stage of scale, design lighter-touch workflows that respect clinical judgment while improving efficiency, and run the cross-functional scale initiatives where no single department holds the outcome.
* Translate ambiguous, cross-functional problems into defined solutions with clear measures of success.
* Contribute to a portfolio of priority initiatives spanning program design, AI enablement, and build-versus-buy decisions.

### **Operationalizing and Scaling New Products, Service Lines, and Clinics**

* Support the operational build-out of new products, service lines, and clinics, from launch through to a steady, scaled state.
* Translate each new offering into the operating model, staffing, workflows, and systems it needs to run reliably.
* Define what good looks like for a new offering, along with the milestones that show it is ready to scale.
* Surface and help resolve risks, dependencies, and execution gaps as offerings move from pilot to full operation.
* Coordinate the handoff to the teams who run each offering day to day, and refine the approach with every launch.

### **Change Management and Execution**

* Help define how Salma Health manages large-scale change, including rollout approaches, governance, and operating rhythms that support adoption and sustain results.
* Identify and help resolve friction points across teams, workflows, and priorities.
* Build repeatable systems and ways of working that strengthen execution as the company scales.

### **Business Operations and Performance**

* Define and track the operational metrics that provide the right visibility into performance across functions.
* Build measurement frameworks and dashboards that replace intuition with data, covering utilization, productivity, and contribution margin across sites.
* Establish prioritization and escalation pathways so that risks, blockers, and decisions reach the right people at the right time.
* Translate data and status into clear executive-level reporting that supports timely, informed decisions.
* Support the preparation of data-informed board materials that communicate progress, priorities, and key initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3 to 8 years of experience across strategy and operations, management consulting, or chief-of-staff function, ideally within healthcare, digital health, or technology.
* A track record of running cross-functional initiatives and operational improvements in a fast-growing organization.
* Strong analytical and financial modeling skills, with the ability to build measurement frameworks and operational dashboards.
* Comfort working with large operational data sets and the tools to analyze them.
* Ability to define and track KPIs across operational and financial domains.
* Comfortable taking ambiguous, cross-functional problems and turning them into structured plans with clear measures of success.
* Strong project management skills and the ability to coordinate across functions without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with comfort presenting to leadership and a range of stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or equivalent advanced degree in a relevant field, with a strong foundation in strategy, operations, growth, or finance.
* Experience operationalizing and scaling new programs or products.
* Familiarity with multi-site healthcare delivery, mental health, clinical operations, and provider networks.
* Understanding of healthcare regulations and reimbursement is helpful.
* Exposure to AI and digital health technologies is a plus.

**Company Mission & Vision**

We are the brain health company of the future that integrates care delivery, technology innovation and research breakthroughs to better understand brain biology and diagnose, treat and ultimately cure brain disorders for all stages of life.

**Who We Are**

At Salma Health, we are transforming the mental and neurological brain healthcare paradigm from a disjointed, one-size-fits-all approach to a comprehensive, end-to-end brain healthcare system featuring advanced diagnostics, evidence-based rapid-acting interventions, and care coordination under one roof.

Through a streamlined system of continuous monitoring and support, Salma Health’s system will deliver much-needed improved outcomes for conditions such as major depressive disorder, PTSD, bipolar disorder, and other conditions with imminent risk, as well as neurodegenerative disorders.

Learn more: https://www.salmahealth.com/

**Compensation & Benefits**

The compensation for this position includes:

* **Base Salary:** $130,00-150,000, depending on experience and qualifications
* **Incentives:** Discretionary bonus or stock option grants based on company and individual performance.
* **Benefits:** Medical, dental, vision, PTO, and additional benefits.

*We reserve the right to modify benefit offerings at any time, in accordance with applicable* *laws.*

**Work Authorization**

Sponsorship for employment authorization may be considered on a case-by-case basis depending on the role and candidate qualification

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**

Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.

Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill

Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

  
**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

 **Education**

High school diploma or equivalent required

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

12

**Time Type**

Part time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$23.50 - $37.50

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  
This part‑time position is eligible for a range of benefits and programs that support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues. jobs.description:
**Responsibilities**

* Recruit and screen potential new hire operator candidates to be placed into training, ensuring that efforts meet the staffing needs of the project.
* Manage new hire and veteran operator training programs to ensure that all operators receive the minimum initial training and that all employees receive required annual and ongoing training.
* Provide and/or manage classroom and behind-the-wheel instruction according to AP3 and contract specifications in all aspects of vehicle operation in the course of passenger transportation, including defensive driving, service area familiarization, passenger loading, unloading and securement, proper manifest documentation, use of on-board equipment, accident and emergency procedures, dispatch and radio communications, and passenger sensitivity.
* Provide and/or manage monthly or annual ongoing and refresher training in topics relevant to the service and service area, and in a timely manner.
* Manage AP3's employer road testing program, including course design, scoring rubric and evaluator calibration, so that evaluations are consistent across supervisors.
* Respond to and/or provide for trained staff response to operator accidents and incidents, ensuring appropriate collection of information, documentation of events, and reporting per AP3 and contract policy.
* Review all vehicular, passenger and employee accidents and incidents for determination of cause and preventability, identifying potential trends to be addressed in future training efforts as well as ensuring that retraining and safety points are assessed according to AP3 policy.
* Serve on the Accident Review Committee and maintain written preventability criteria so that determinations are consistent and defensible.
* Manage all aspects of AP3's FTA drug and alcohol testing programin compliance with FTA regulations, including pre-employment, random, reasonable suspicion, post-accident, return-to-duty and follow-up testing.
* Serve as, or as backup to, the Designated Employer Representative (DER); construct and maintain the random testing pool and verify selection frequency and rates; maintain a clear post-accident testing decision process and the applicable timeframes; and deliver or coordinate the required reasonable suspicion training for all supervisors.
* Manage the third-party administrator, Medical Review Officer, Substance Abuse Professional and collection site relationships. Conduct regular reviews of local testing facilities ensuring compliance with federal and AP3 policy, maintain chain-of-custody integrity and confidential recordkeeping, complete required program reporting, and keep AP3's drug and alcohol policy current with regulatory change.
* Establish a functional Safety Committee of operators and staff to review safety concerns and make recommendations to management for additional safety efforts.
* Own AP3's written safety programs, including the Injury and Illness Prevention Program, heat illness prevention, workplace violence prevention, emergency action and hazard communication plans.
* Build and manage the dash cam coaching program, including event review workflow, severity thresholds, coaching documentation and driver scorecards.
* Assist operations and maintenance departments in identifying additional or refresher training needs based on current trends within the employee base.
* Ensure complete and accurate documentation of all training activities and accurate completion of all training-related employee records.
* Work with AP3 leadership and claims partners to ensure that all liability and workers' compensation claims are handled promptly and effectively, in an effort to reduce financial liability as well as recoup on all subrogatable claims.
* Proactively manage all employee injury claims to minimize lost time and light duty claims. Work with local medical facilities to ensure that injured employees are placed on light duty as quickly as possible and are returned to full-duty status promptly.
* Conduct regular audits of employee training files and vehicle maintenance files, and conduct regular facility safety audits ensuring compliance with Cal/OSHA and EPA regulations and related AP3 policies.
* Ensure that operator performance reviews, ride-alongs, road checks and evaluations are conducted according to AP3 and contract policy and requirements. Provide feedback and follow up for operator performance reviews and identify individual training needs where necessary.
* Hire and manage all safety department employees including classroom and behind-the-wheel instructors, ensuring that all safety staff have the appropriate qualifications, certifications and training, and that staff assignments are made in consideration of applicable budget line items.
* Write and maintain standard operating procedures for the safety program's core processes.
* Provide regular reports to AP3 leadership and client agencies on safety department efforts, claims status, training efforts, accident history, workers' compensation claims status, and other required information.
* Coordinate all dispatcher and reservations activities.
* Maintain a positive work environment by providing all employees with fair and equitable supervision and encouraging professional growth.
* Monitor performance of dispatchers, call-takers and vehicles.
* Evaluate and manage staff performance.

A key part of this partnership activity is for the internal security management to routinely consult on the needs, priorities, and opportunities to deliver greater value in the pursuit of the success of the site security program.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Global Events Content team is seeking an experienced Event Program Manager to own two content mandates for 1P flagship events: the embargo content lifecycle for confidential launch sessions, and workshop (interactive, hands-on) content and delivery. For embargo, this role manages confidential launch session content end-to-end from session intake through post-launch, in close partnership with Product Marketing and launch operations. For workshops, it serves as the Event Content team’s primary liaison with the workshop content and delivery platform team, ensuring hands-on sessions run smoothly. The ideal candidate is strategic-minded, highly organized, operationally rigorous, security-conscious, and comfortable coordinating across Product Marketing, launch operations, event technology, and vendor partners in a fast-paced global environment.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the end-to-end embargo content lifecycle for 1P flagship events, from session intake through post-launch, working closely with Product Marketing and launch operations to develop and execute event content strategy for confidential launch sessions.
* Oversee embargo content tooling, manage permissions and data security protocols, and drive decisions on tooling changes tied to process improvement.
* Design and continuously improve embargo workstream processes, identifying gaps and implementing changes that increase operational rigor and reduce risk as the program scales.
* Serve as the Event Content team’s primary liaison with the workshop content and delivery platform team, coordinating across speakers, service teams, and event operations to ensure hands-on sessions run smoothly at 1P flagship events.
* Manage capacity planning, workback schedules, and speaker communications for hands-on sessions.
* Coordinate with Demand Generation, Event Operations, Event Technology, and vendor partners to ensure content is published, promoted, updated, and surfaced correctly across web and mobile catalogs.
* Create and maintain documentation including playbooks, standardized processes, program narratives, and strategy documents, some of which are reviewed by senior leadership.
* Track and report on workstream performance metrics including CSAT scores, attendance, deadline compliance, catalog dwell time, and catalog activity to inform decisions and demonstrate impact.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional programs or marketing campaigns from concept to completion
* Experience using content management systems and content tools
* Experience using data and metrics to drive insights.
* Proficiency in data management tools (e.g., Airtable, Excel).

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Event planning experience, including onsite event execution, for large-scale conferences (10-25k+ attendees).
* Experience with launch marketing.
* Experience with product marketing or product management.
* Experience with events.

jobs.title: Packaging Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Allogene:**

Allogene Therapeutics, with headquarters in South San Francisco, is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of allogeneic chimeric antigen receptor T cell (AlloCAR T) products for cancer and autoimmune disease. Led by a management team with significant experience in cell therapy, Allogene is developing a pipeline of “off-the-shelf” CAR T cell product candidates with the goal of delivering readily available cell therapy on-demand, more reliably, and at greater scale to more patients.

**About the role:**

Allogene Therapeutics is seeking a highly motivated Packaging Operations Manager to support the design, qualification, and lifecycle management of packaging systems, labeling components, and cold chain packaging supporting the manufacture and distribution of Allogene's clinical and commercial cell therapy products. This role helps ensure that packaging and labeling systems for the company’s first product launch comply with GMP, regulatory, and patient-specific requirements while maintaining product integrity throughout manufacturing, cryogenic storage, transportation, and delivery. This role supports the preparation and launch of Allogene’s first commercial cell therapy product.

The position will be located at Allogene headquarters in South San Francisco, CA. The ideal candidate is an individual who is interested in working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and highly collaborative biotech environment with a willingness and ability to successfully take on new challenges.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Packaging Engineering: Own the design, qualification, and lifecycle management of secondary/tertiary packaging systems for cryopreserved cell therapy products, ensuring product quality and protection across manufacturing, storage, shipping, and clinical-to-commercial transitions.
* Cold Chain Packaging Systems: Support the technical performance and qualification of cold chain shipping systems (dry shippers, temperature monitors, data loggers, insulated containers) by managing Validation protocols, thermal mapping, and lane/transportation validation studies, and analyzing shipping data to drive corrective actions.
* Packaging Design and Engineering: Support the technical lifecycle, specifications, and GMP-compliant documentation of printed packaging components (labels, cartons, IFUs, inserts) and lead Allogene's commercial packaging design and validation - including supplier qualification, cryogenic/transport performance testing, artwork and material selection, and packaging-related risk assessments impacting patient material.
* CMO and Supplier Management: manage chosen CMOs for secondary and tertiary packaging, including manufacturers, contract packagers, and contracted cold chain distribution.
* Artwork and Printing Management: Serve as the lead for artwork implementation, verifying manufacturability, packaging compatibility, and specification alignment while supporting change control and collaborating with Regulatory Affairs, Marketing and Quality on approved labeling updates. Manage print suppliers, coordinate printing and troubleshoot printing issues.
* First product launch: Ensure completion of activities to ensure on on-time launch for Allogene’s first commercial product. Coordinate all packaging related launch activities.

**Position Requirements & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Packaging Science, or a related field with at least 3 years of experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, with a strong preference for cell or gene therapy, package design and development, and/or cold chain management.
* Knowledge of cGMP regulations and regulatory expectations; familiarity with FDA, EMA, and Annex 13 labeling requirements is a plus.
* Familiarity with cryogenic or cold-chain packaging and autologous or allogeneic cell therapy supply chains is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of artwork management and print processes for packaging components.
* Experience with product launches is preferred.
* Ability to communicate and collaborate with different stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical Operations, Process Development, and others.
* Ability to effectively work in a fast-paced, biotech environment while dealing with ambiguity.
* Excellent organizational skills and an ability to prioritize effectively to deliver results within reasonably established timelines.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a desire to improve upon established processes.
* Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S.

We offer a chance to work with talented people in a collaborative environment and provide a top-notch compensation and benefits package, which includes an annual performance bonus, equity, health insurance, generous time off (including 2 annual holiday company-wide shutdowns) and much more. The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000 per year. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, business needs, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

As an equal opportunity employer, Allogene is committed to a diverse workforce. Employment decisions regarding recruitment and selection will be made without discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, genetic information or characteristic, gender identity and expression, veteran status, or other non-job-related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state and local laws. We also embrace differences in experience and background, and welcome diversity of opinions and thought, designed to create a stronger and better Allogene that is focused on developing life-changing products for patients.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Looking for stability? Join Woodgrain!** We’re growing fast and offering **lifetime careers** in a supportive work environment.

About Woodgrain:

Woodgrain is one of the top millwork operations in the world, with locations throughout the United States and Chile. With 70 years of quality manufacturing craftsmanship and service, Woodgrain is a top producer of mouldings, doors, and windows, as well as a premier distributor of specialty building products. Woodgrain Inc. is headquartered in Fruitland, Idaho with six divisions and over 45 manufacturing and warehouse facilities in the United States and South America. Since 1954, Woodgrain is proud to be family owned and operated.

**Summary:**

The position reports directly to the General Manager of the branch. This role is responsible for the successful execution of warehousing, production and delivery activities. The position requires the ability to develop, implement, control and adjust branch plans to implement the company's growth strategy while simultaneously leading team to achieve operational goals and efficiency targets for the branch.

The focus and scope of this job is to ensure that the branch:

* Successfully execute the company's strategic plan in a comprehensive and systematic manner. The Operations Manager should be focused on driving the company's growth strategy.
* Develops, implements, and executes coordinated strategies and tactical plans to improve the operational and financial performance of the distribution center; and
* Achieves operating results that align with the company's strategic goals.
* Demonstrates a safety-first culture - meeting or exceeding improvement targets.

Personal initiative, coupled with a sense of competitive drive, and the ability to stay focused on results despite changing conditions, is the key to achieving the performance objectives of this job. Because the business environment changes rapidly, the work involves innovation and creativity in planning and problem solving. Sound decision-making is required to implement practical, timely solutions.

Self-assurance and the confidence to purposely drive toward results while leading and engaging the commitment of others is essential. A leadership style that is firm and goal-oriented, and yet motivates, trains, and engages others in an enthusiastic way is important. The emphasis on building rapport and relationships with individuals and groups requires an outgoing, poised and persuasive communication style.

Because the pace of the work is faster than average, the ability to thoroughly assess and analyze information to make sound decisions is critical. The scope of the job requires a strong leader who can quickly build trust and associate engagement. An effective Operations Manager is skilled at communicating the company's vision and goals as well as the importance of each associate's role in contributing to company success.

The job requires the ability to act independently with a high degree of commitment, urgency, and confidence. Dedication and commitment and the pursuit of high standards of achievement are expected in this position. As the company is in the midst of strategic change, the position requires an individual that flexible, resilient and who is excited by the opportunities that growth brings.

**Essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Effective and efficient management of Production, Warehouse and Delivery operations.
  + Ensures a safe work environment for all employees.
  + Oversees and develops plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees by analyzing and adjusting daily, weekly and monthly to the volume of business in the branch.
  + Ensures the accuracy of the inventory on site at the Branch.

* Generates, analyzes and takes action on all IT systems and other reports related to the production, warehouse and delivery.
* Serves as the final reviewer of the quality of work produced by the Interior and Exterior door shops to meet the expectations of our customers before shipment.
* Ensures as all new employees are fully trained on and capable in all aspects of their job. Cross trains where appropriate.
* Protects the assets of the company by implementing appropriate security and process controls.

  

* Operations Planning

Stanford University is one of Silicon Valley's largest employers - and one of the most unique. Our mission is to educate future leaders and promote interdisciplinary, world-class research and teaching. This passion makes Stanford an intensely creative, rewarding, and challenging place to work. At Stanford University, not only are you part of an exceptional team that values innovation and education, but you also become part of a culture that brings out the best in you. Stanford is committed to fostering a workplace culture that promotes diversity, collaboration, and professional growth. Our culture offers career development programs, competitive pay that reflects market trends and benefits that increase financial stability and promote healthy, fulfilling lives.

Research—the creation of new knowledge—is key to Stanford’s educational mission. Stanford research has led to breakthrough remedies, devices, tools, and concepts, and hundreds of initiatives solely for the betterment of humanity. Among the inventions and discoveries that have resulted from Stanford research are MRI technology, DNA cloning, the Pill, heart transplantation, and digital music.

Stanford is investing unprecedented resources in the Office of Research Administration (ORA) due to a growth in the research enterprise that continues to surpass 12% yearly. The Contract & Grant Officer position provides high-quality, personalized services and expertise to support our faculty and campus community. ORA submits over 5,000 new proposals, reviews and negotiates over 7,000 agreements, and manages more than 7,500 active sponsored projects annually with a total research budget approaching $2 billion.

The Property Management Office (PMO) is an integral part of the Office of Research Administration (ORA). Through a network of approximately 300 Department Property Administrators (DPAs) throughout the University, PMO ensures equipment is effectively managed from the time of acquisition through disposal. PMO is responsible for the oversight, accounting, compliance, training, and implementation of policies and procedures to manage a $1.3 billion dollar infrastructure of *moveable equipment* used in support of the education and research mission of Stanford.

At Stanford University, base pay represents only one aspect of the comprehensive rewards package. Specifics about the rewards package for this position may be discussed during the hiring process.

The Training and Communications Program Manager in the Property Management Office (PMO) provides overall leadership, coordination, and management of the program. jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Promex Industries specializes in custom assembly processes focusing on complex microelectronics and small component assemblies that require precise fabrication. With a longstanding presence in Silicon Valley, Promex offers a fully integrated, US-based facility dedicated to supporting biotech instrument and medical device companies from prototype to full-scale production.

**Position Summary:**

The Quality Assurance Technician supports and maintains the company's Quality Management System (QMS). The Technician administers the training and calibration programs, maintains controlled quality records, supports internal and external audits, and helps drive nonconformance, corrective action and quality data activities to closure. Working alongside the QC Inspector, the Technician applies inspection expertise (IPC workmanship standards, sampling plans and precision measurement) to support incoming and outgoing inspection, resolve acceptance questions and provide inspection backup when needed.

**Essential Duties:**

**QMS Operational Support**

· Administer the calibration program: maintain the equipment list and recall schedule, coordinate outside calibration vendors, review calibration certificates for acceptability, perform and record in-house verifications, and quarantine and report out-of-tolerance equipment.

· Maintain the training program, including the training matrix by position, the training schedule, and tracking of due, overdue and recurring training and re-qualifications.

· Schedule and coordinate training sessions with internal trainers, department supervisors and outside providers; notify employees and supervisors of upcoming and overdue training.

· Prepare for and support internal, customer and registrar audits by retrieving records, demonstrating processes and following up on findings.

· Document nonconforming material (NCMR), support MRB disposition, and gather objective evidence for corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) and supplier corrective actions (SCAR); track actions to closure.

· Collect, check and verify quality records to ensure the activities are completed as planned.

· Conduct ESD, 5S and in-process audit.

· Support material compliance management and compile compliance reports per guidance

**Inspection**

· Serve as technical resource to the QC Inspectors and operators on borderline acceptance questions.

· Conduct incoming, in-process and outgoing inspection of purchased materials and SMT assemblies to IPC-A-600/IPC-A-610, drawings and customer requirements.

· Perform specialized measurements using a Micro-Vu (or equivalent) vision measuring system, calipers, micrometers, gauges and microscopes, X-ray imaging, and XRF for plating thickness and RoHS/material verification.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

· High school diploma or GED.

· 5+ years of working experience and 3+ years of quality experience in an electronics manufacturing (SMT/PCBA) environment, including support of QMS operation.

· Working knowledge of IPC-A-610; familiarity with IPC J-STD-001 and IPC-A-600.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook, with accurate data entry.

· Working knowledge of QMS requirements (e.g., ISO 9001) for training, calibration, document control and records.

· Understanding of attribute sampling plans (ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 and c=0) and basic calibration concepts (traceability, tolerance, recall intervals).

· Hands-on experience with precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges) and inspection microscopes

· Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs and specifications.

**Key Competencies:**

· **Organization & Follow-Through:** Manages schedules, due dates and recalls so that training and calibration never lapse, and follows open items to closure.

· **Computer Literacy:** Familiar with Microsoft Office, QMS software and other applications for record maintenance; learns new systems quickly.

· **Technical Judgment:** Applies acceptance criteria consistently and escalates borderline conditions appropriately.

· **Documentation Discipline:** Keeps records complete, accurate, legible and on time.

· **Attention to Detail:** Catches gaps and errors in records as well as workmanship and dimensional defects.

· **Communication:** Follows up clearly with employees, supervisors, vendors and the QC Inspector on training, calibration, inspection and corrective action items.

· **Integrity & Independence:** Holds the line on quality requirements under schedule pressure.

**Preferred Skills:**

· Associate degree or technical certificate in electronics, manufacturing or quality technology.

· Current IPC-A-610 Certified IPC Specialist (CIS); J-STD-001 certification a plus.

· Experience in an ISO 13485 or AS9100 quality system, including participation in audits.

· Experience with a Micro-Vu or other vision/CMM measuring system, and with XRF, X-ray or AOI inspection equipment.

· Experience in MIL-STD-883 optical inspection.

**Work Environment:**

· Combination of quality office and manufacturing/inspection-lab environment, including ESD-controlled areas and cleanrooms; requires wearing ESD/cleanroom equipment.

· Regular computer work for record maintenance, plus periods of sitting or standing at microscopes and inspection stations with close visual work and fine hand manipulation.

· Occasionally lifts and moves materials up to 25 lbs.

· Works with XRF equipment that emits ionizing radiation; must follow the company radiation safety program.

· This position may require access to export-controlled (ITAR) technical data; if so, the candidate must qualify as a U.S. Person.

jobs.title: Research Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About AfterQuery**
====================

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

**Why Apply**
=============

**Massive Opportunity:** Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

**Founding Impact:** You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

**Equity & Growth:** Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

**Strong Team:** Our founding team has experience from Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, and Morgan Stanley — work alongside world-class engineers and researchers.

**Overview**
------------

AfterQuery is hiring a Research Program Manager to run the operations behind its research programs: public benchmark releases, collaborations with academic and industry partners, and the research roadmap. You own the coordination, external relationships, and progress tracking that keep the program moving, and you are welcome to contribute to the research itself, from benchmark design to co-authoring publications.

This is a technical, hands-on role, not a pure coordination one. You will read results tables, run evals, sanity-check numbers before they go public, and turn loosely specified research needs into engineering and operational roadmaps. You will also be the program's voice to external partners, so clear writing and confident communication across researchers, executives, and academics are as important as technical fluency. You work daily with researchers, engineers, domain experts, and go-to-market partners.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the point of contact for collaborations with academic and industry partners, including fellowships, grants, and joint research projects, and run each from scoping through delivery.
* Coordinate benchmark releases end to end, from launch checklist through publication, and keep releases on cadence.
* Maintain AfterQuery's leaderboards and benchmark sites, and verify every result before it goes to a community leaderboard or publication.
* Track progress across all active research projects. Anticipate resourcing gaps and technical bottlenecks, unblock projects that fall behind, and escalate with a clear recommendation when a timeline or scope needs to change.
* Coordinate the expert pool for upcoming benchmarks: forecast expert needs, manage capacity, and keep contributor logistics running.
* Write the program's external and internal communications: launch briefs, partner updates, planning documents, and status memos that turn technical detail into clear, actionable summaries.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 1-3+ years in research operations, technical program management, or a similar role in a fast-moving research or engineering organization.
* Technical background in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field, with working Python and SQL.
* Evaluation literacy: you have taken part in evaluating a product, an agent, or a foundation model, can read a results table, and can tell when a number should not be trusted.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You can distill a technical result into a summary a partner, executive, or academic collaborator can act on, and you write documents people actually read.
* A track record of running cross-functional programs end to end, including managing external partners, contractors, or collaborators.
* Comfort with ambiguity and building processes from scratch, and the judgment to keep processes light so researchers stay effective.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Graduate degree or research experience in a technical field.
* Contributed to a benchmark, dataset, or evaluation project in any role.
* Familiarity with public leaderboards or open research communities.
* Exposure to programs with external partners, such as fellowships, grants, or academic collaborations.
* Exposure to expert or annotator pools, or other human-data work.
* Comfort with lightweight dashboards or building small tools with AI assistants.

**Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):**
----------------------------------------------

The ARIA Non-Invasive Neurostimulation/Neuromodulation (NINM) Frontier Science Hub Initiative is a new multi-million dollar multi-year privately-funded endeavor in the Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences, led by Vice Chair for Research Dr. Andrew Krystal. As a high-profile, multi-institutional research venture, the ARIA NINM Frontier Science Hub spans a consortium of three leading universities—Yale, Stanford, and UCSF—and will support up to 15 new multi-site and department-based research programs. **Customer Success Lead**

Hybrid (San Francisco, CA) Full-time

**About Alethios**

Alethios is a decentralized health research platform. We give researchers one place to build a protocol, manage participants, and integrate wearables and surveys, in real-time, so they can go from formulation to validation without the friction of traditional, site-based research. We're a mission-driven company, focused on lowering the barriers to human health research for both researchers and participants. And we're growing quickly: more studies, more researchers, more categories, every month.

We're looking for someone who cares about human health, sweats the details, builds things, and wants to be at a mission-driven company. This is the first hire in this function. You'll define what customer success means at Alethios, reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with Business Operations and Engineering.

**The role**

You'll own customer success end to end: study startup, go-live, and study ops. Day-to-day, that means working directly with researchers and sponsors to get their studies launched and run well.

The bigger opportunity is what you build while doing it. We launch 5 to 10 studies a month and that number is growing fast. The tools you create, such as automated study-health monitoring, templated onboarding, or AI-assisted client reporting, are what will take it substantially higher without growing the team. The best people here make themselves more leveraged every month, and this role is designed for that.

The work comes down to four things: relationship management, tool building, excellent follow-through, and both an instinct and an analytic approach for what makes a great study.

**What you'll do**

* Run study kickoff and onboarding: offer input on protocol digitization and study decentralization
* Monitor study health: enrollment pacing, participant compliance, data flow from surveys and wearables
* Own the client communication cadence: status updates, mid-study check-ins, results walkthroughs. Build the systems that generate these updates
* Coordinate with our distribution team on kit timing, client product receipt, and participant mailing
* Drive renewals and expansion: a great first study should become a second
* Build the machine: automated study-health dashboards, templated onboarding flows, self-serve client resources, AI-assisted reporting
* Be the voice of the customer to engineering: feed pain points and patterns back into the product roadmap

**Who you are**

* You're product-minded: you've built workflows, automations, or internal tools, and you reach for AI tooling by default
* You're health-focused, with either a serious hunger to learn and analyze data or a clinical/research background
* You prepare for every meeting: clients notice, and so do we
* You're organized under pressure: multiple concurrent studies won't rattle you
* You're creative: when the obvious process doesn't fit, you invent one that does

**Nice to have**

* Clinical credentials or a health sciences background
* Experience at an early-stage company where you built the function rather than inherited it
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Intercom, or IRB submission tools

**Benefits**

We want our team to feel supported, in work and in life. Alethios offers:

* **Competitive compensation** including equity that reflects the value and impact you bring from day one
* **Health benefits**: we cover 100% of healthcare and dental plan premiums for employees
* **Generous PTO** so you can recharge fully and show up at your best
* **Mission-driven work** that directly lowers barriers to evidence generation and makes research more accessible
* **A dynamic team**: small and collaborative, where every voice matters and cross-disciplinary thinking shapes the product daily
* **SF office with flexibility**: this role is hybrid out of our San Francisco office

Benefits:

The Incident and Escalation Management team (IEM) is part of Datadog's Global Support Engineering (GSE) organization. We're looking for experts with a background in incident management and escalation handling to provide fast incident response, clear ownership, and calm, confident communication for our global customer base.

  

In this individual contributor role, you will play a key part in customer communication, technical engagement, and incident management for our global customers. You will also implement processes and automations, use the same incident and case management tools we build for our customers, and help shape how they evolve.

  

*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture — the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.*

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Drive incidents and escalations to resolution from start to finish, including triage, coordination with our support, engineering and product teams. Own the response and keep customers and internal teams informed throughout.
* Independently coordinate cross-functional stakeholders through complex incidents and escalations, making the call on prioritization, response strategy, and when to pull in additional teams or leadership.
* Own communications during active incidents, including sensitive, large-scale, and publicly visible events, adapting the message for customers, internal teams, and leadership.
* Lead projects that deliver operational improvements to how IEM detects, manages, and communicates during incidents and escalations as Datadog and its products evolve.
* Create, maintain, and improve incident and escalation documentation, runbooks, and training materials, and lead retrospectives that turn individual incidents into durable process change.
* Mentor peers on incident and escalation management best practices, and contribute to interviewing and hiring.
* Design and implement real-time and proactive monitoring of customer infrastructure to surface customer-impacting risks before they escalate.
* Identify recurring cloud infrastructure and product issues across incidents and escalations, and partner with Engineering to feed findings back and reduce recurrence.

  

**Who You Are:**

* 5+ years of related professional experience, including experience in incident management and customer escalations, with demonstrable ownership of complex incidents and critical customer situations; experience in a SaaS, cloud, or observability environment is a plus
* 2+ years of experience in a hands-on technical role at a software or cloud company, such as Support Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or a similar technical function

* Ability to correlate behaviors across known system interdependencies, assess customer and technical impact, and make sound decisions while remaining calm in high-pressure and ambiguous situations
* Experience independently coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and driving complex incidents and escalations toward resolution
* Experience driving projects from conception through delivery, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and customer-facing audiences
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science/Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

  

*Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the below qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.*

  

**Benefits and Growth:**

* Generous and competitive US benefits
* New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
* Continuous career development and pathing opportunities
* Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
* Best in breed onboarding
* Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally
* Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

  

*Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.*

#LI-Hybrid

**About Datadog:**

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale.
