jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

Overhaul is a supply chain integrity solutions company that allows shippers to connect disparate sources of data into the first fully transparent situational analysis engine designed for the logistics industry. Data that is transformed into critical insights can instantly trigger corrective actions, impacting everything from temperature control to handling requirements or package-level tracking, ensuring cargo arrives at its destination safely, undamaged, and on time. We are a dynamic, innovative, and fun team who is highly committed to our customers’ experiences and our Mission and Vision.

**The Role**

As a Key Account Manager based in San Jose, you own a portfolio of Overhaul’s strategic enterprise accounts, accelerating growth by highlighting Overhaul’s Enterprise business solutions that greatly increase supply chain visibility, integrity, and security. Most of your accounts will be based in or near Silicon Valley, though your portfolio may also include accounts headquartered elsewhere. Through your expertise and understanding of each client’s needs, you outline uniquely beneficial combinations of our software and services solutions that deliver on customer and business goals while creating demand for the future.

You are enthusiastic about our service suite and inspiring clients to share in your enthusiasm while retaining current service and expanding future value from Overhaul’s suite of services. You have developed a keen ability for identifying roadblocks and overcoming obstacles to increase business and enhance the client experience. You flourish in a fast-paced environment and are energized by being on the ground with your accounts — this role involves regular on-site presence at client offices throughout the Bay Area, working in person with the teams you support.

**Key Account Manager Responsibilities:**

* Retain customer relationships, while growing the Overhaul service suite within the assigned customer base.
* Interacting with C-Level and VP-Level Executives, driving the digital transformation strategy for assigned account base.
* Maintain existing customer relationships and satisfaction, while gaining new customer contacts for Overhaul services. Create cross-department relationships and value in the customer base.
* Manage the pricing, negotiation, and execution of client contract renewals and expansion.
* While selling existing solutions, work within the business to advocate for solving additional customer challenges, resulting in revenue quota attainment.
* Working with operations, marketing, product, engineering, and data science departments to align future client needs with product and services roadmap.
* Coordinate and partner with Customer Success Management (CSM) team members for strategic business reviews with clients to guide vision and execution of expanded Overhaul services.
* Ability to navigate the customer and the business to reach revenue goals.
* Maintain a regular on-site presence for your Silicon Valley-based accounts — for example, splitting your week across one or more client offices in the Bay Area — while managing any accounts based outside the region remotely or through periodic travel, depending on account assignment.

**About you:**

* Demonstrable history of achieving company revenue goals and growth while enabling a long-term customer relationship
* Capable of thriving in fast-paced Start-Up environment
* 5+ years’ experience in enterprise revenue generating or account management role
* Previous management of Fortune 1000 accounts
* Based in or willing to relocate to the San Jose / Silicon Valley area, with the flexibility to work on-site at multiple client offices across the Bay Area each week
* Previous supply chain management, logistics, law enforcement, and/or cargo security experience
* Ability to travel regionally between client offices across the Bay Area, and further domestically or internationally as needed for accounts based outside the region.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
  + This role will communicate within all paygrades at the customer base and within Overhaul. This is from dock worker to senior executive level.
* Financial comprehension for account(s) forecasting, pipeline creation and management, invoicing, etc.

* Excellent analytical and communication skills with strong business acumen and intuition
* Self-motivated – possess a strong desire to be successful and self-directed
* Passion for fast-paced, high-growth and challenging environments
* Experience navigating a complex, global customers across all departments: Logistics, Operations, Security, Cyber Security, etc.

* 401(k) Matching

* Employee Assistance Program
* Self paced Development & Training program
* Rotating company ‘Perks at Work’ program
* Flexible PTO policy

jobs.description:
Verenigde Staten

San Francisco

We are seeking a highly driven, entrepreneurial, and results-oriented National Account Manager to lead and grow our Biscoff business at Target. This individual will own the Target business, including strategy, revenue growth, profitability, operational execution, and cross-functional leadership. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Target's systems, processes, and ways of working and is equally comfortable building long-term strategic growth plans as they are rolling up their sleeves to resolve deductions, manage Vendor Income agreements, troubleshoot inventory issues, or navigate item setup challenges. This role requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, financial acumen, customer leadership, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will serve as the internal expert on all things Target and be accountable for delivering sustainable, profitable growth.

  

### **Functiebeschrijving**

Strategic Account Leadership

* Develop and execute the overall Target account strategy to deliver revenue, share, distribution, and profit objectives.
* Own annual business plans, customer growth strategies, assortment recommendations, promotional plans, and innovation launches.
* Lead Joint Business Planning initiatives and identify opportunities to expand the business within Target stores and digital channels.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across Target buying, planning, inventory, and merchandising teams.

Business and Financial Management

* Identify and resolve operational, inventory, supply chain, and compliance issues that impact sales, service levels, or profitability.

Cross-functional Leadership

AtQnity, we\u2019re more than a global leader in materials and solutions for advanced electronics and high-tech industries \u2013 we\u2019re a tight-knit team that is motivated by new possibilities, and always up for a challenge. All our dedicated teams contribute to making cutting-edge technology possible. We value forward-thinking challengers, boundary-pushers, and diverse perspectives across all our departments, because we know we play a critical role in the world enabling faster progress for all. Learn how you can start or jumpstart your career with us.
  
  
**Location:** Virtual Office in USA - Preferred location PHOENIX, ARIZONA
  
Position Overview
  
Qnity Electronics Semiconductor Technologies has an opening forLead Account Manager in theAdvanced Cleans& Slurry Technologies (ACST) business. \u00A0ACST develops cleaning solutions for semiconductor customers.\u00A0 The Lead Account Manager will be responsible for the growth of Qnity's market share at various customers across United States through managing the day-to-day sales responsibilities for these customers in the region.\u00A0 Working in the advanced Cleans and Slurry segment within the semiconductor industry, there will be a need to communicate with internal R and marketing functions and develop an understanding of the customer needs and roadmap. There will be a strong requirement to introduce new products as well as to validate value propositions.\u00A0 Understanding and coordinating the supply chain and logistics channels for the customers in the region is also key and where possible working with the supporting functions to deliver cost saving and value propositions for the customer base.
  
We are looking for a self-starter and passionate Account Manager with a first-hand sales experience who has the ability to think and plan strategically as well as to combine technical& commercial attitude and who can develop a business.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Ability to lead, align, and motivate diverse stake holders; having the business acumen to define a global/local account strategy that considers intricacies and customer\u2019s needs of individual regions; manage defined plan\u2019s and team(s) to achieve objectives; Assertiveness to request the necessary interaction from the customer\u2019s organization to help meet the defined goals; Ability to work across multiple functions and potentially global internal/external organizations to achieve both local and global goals.
  
  
**Skills:**  

* Identification and meeting the needs of current and perspective customers by promoting and selling products to increase and defend market share.
* Providing consultative, interactive and integrated Sales and technical solutions to the customers.
* Creating, developing and maintaining strong and effective customer relationships.
* Elaborating strategic account plans by using extensive knowledge of customer\u2019s total needs and Qnity product offerings, sharing with key stakeholders, participating in regular account team meetings to measure progress towards set goals and promote long term value creation.
* Producing appropriate sales forecasts and sharing business and industry intelligence with Qnity counterparts (Marketing, R, Quality, Supply Chain, etc.) that may impact short& med-term demand.
* Achieving sales goals and objectives in assigned territory/customers as derived by business strategies and marketing plans to drive profitable growth.
* Working intensively with\u00A0Salesforce.com
* A key component of the role will include a good awareness of competitive activities and a plan to effectively compete with the competition.
* Responsible to coordinate and lead regular communications and interactions with the customer.\u00A0 This will include coordination of engagement activities to grow market share, as well as commercial interactions. Other communications as necessary (business continuity concerns, logistics, etc.)
* Will be responsible to coordinate communication within the global account team if applicable.
* Develop long-term business relationships.\u00A0 Relationships will be developed and grown within all levels at customer.
* Effectively work with other functional groups within Qnity to drive satisfaction both within Qnity and at customer.\u00A0 Groups include Product Quality Engineer, Demand Planning, Manufacturing, Customer Service, Quality, etc.

**Required Qualifications:** \u00A0
  
  

* Technical degree or Business degree required, additional MBA preferred.
* Knowledge in semiconductor manufacture, semiconductor customer, and associated Wet Etch Cleans, post-CMP cleans, or Slurry processes and related consumables.
* 3+ years of relative semiconductor industry experience required
* Proficient in planning/writing business case on how to proceed with a defined strategy.
* Proven track record of growing market share with customers; existing Semiconductor customer and other related relationships a plus.
* Team building, and engagement management skills.
* Ability to travel to customer sites in US, up to 50% of the time, possible global travel 1 time per year.

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Professional proficiency in Business Mandarin and English

jobs.title: Account Manager/Technical Manager (7972)
jobs.description:
**Account Manager/Technical Manager (7972)**
============================================

**TSMC North America**

**Account Manager / Technical Manager**

**Overview of Role**

TSMC North America is seeking an Account Manager / Technical Manager, based in San Jose, CA, to own the technical account relationship for one of TSMC’s key global customers serving diverse sectors, including data center, networking, broadband, and industrial markets. You will serve as a primary interface between the customer’s technical and procurement organizations, driving and managing both front-end silicon technology and backend packaging programs (2.5D/3D advanced packaging). The role demands fluency in semiconductor design, processes, and advanced packaging, strong commercial acumen, and the emotional intelligence to build synergy within an established, high-workload account team while operating independently and keeping tight alignment with TSMC headquarters. You will report to the Account Management team leader and partner with senior customer and TSMC stakeholders to strengthen the partnership and deliver measurable value across cost, quality, and time-to-market. TSMC currently operates a hybrid work schedule (4 days in office).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the account relationship for the assigned strategic customer, serving as the primary TSMC technical and commercial interface and sustaining executive-level alignment.
* Manage the customer’s selected front-end silicon and advanced packaging programs — 2.5D/3D packaging — from planning through production ramp. Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding customer’s product roadmaps and positioning the appropriate TSMC technologies.
* Translate customer product requirements into actionable programs with R&D, Planning, Field Technical Support (FTS), Business Development, Operations, and Finance, and coordinate closely with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.
* Anticipate and address customer challenges, balancing TSMC’s objectives with the customer’s product and operational priorities.
* Manage capacity and fulfillment cycles with procurement, design, and business units, ensuring consistent demand creation and supply alignment.
* Provide structured business analysis and briefings for Account Directors, VPs, and senior TSMC executives.

***Minimum Qualifications***

* BS/MS in Engineering, Physical Science, Business, or a related technical discipline.
* 12+ years of combined experience in account management, applications/field engineering, technical program management, or foundry/OSAT/OEM supply chain within the semiconductor industry.
* Strong knowledge of semiconductor processes, fab operations, and supply chain dynamics.
* Strong project management with the ability to synthesize complex technical and business insights into clear executive recommendations.
* High emotional intelligence and proven ability to build strong working relationships and integrate into an established, capacity-constrained, customer-facing team.
* Excellent executive communication, negotiation, and conflict‑management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ability to analyze and interpret financial statements.

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Prior TSMC or foundry account management / customer service experience supporting North America accounts.
* Experience in semiconductor design, device, process, product engineering, or advanced packaging.
* Experience coordinating across highly matrixed, multi-geography teams and with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.
* Bilingual in Mandarin and English.

***Travel Expectations***

* Monthly travel (~10%) to customer sites within the USA.
* Annual travel to TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.

**Company Description**

As a trusted technology and capacity provider, TSMC is driven by the desire to be:

* **The world’s leading dedicated semiconductor foundry**
* **The technology leader with a strong reputation for manufacturing excellence**
* **Advancing semiconductor manufacturing innovations to enable the future of technology**

TSMC pioneered the pure-play foundry business model when it was founded in 1987 and has been the world’s leading dedicated semiconductor foundry ever since. The Company supports a thriving ecosystem of global customers and partners with the industry’s leading process technologies and a portfolio of design enablement solutions to unleash innovation for the global semiconductor industry. With global operations spanning Asia, Europe, and North America, TSMC serves as a committed corporate citizen around the world.

In North America, TSMC has a strong sales and service organization that works with customers by helping them achieve silicon success with cutting-edge technologies and manufacturing excellence. The Company has continued to accelerate its R&D investment and staffing in recent years and is expanding its manufacturing footprint to support customer innovation with 3D IC technologies and optimal manufacturing capacity.

**Export Control**

For positions requiring access to technical data subject to export control regulations, including Export Administration Regulations, TSMC North America may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Government for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon TSMC North America obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by the U.S. Government.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Packaging Industry
jobs.description:
**Who is Golden West Packaging Group (GWPG)?**

We are a leading West Coast mill-independent specialty packaging and printing business. We are the people behind the innovative packaging solutions that make it possible for our customers’ products to reach our community – at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between.

With 13 manufacturing facilities primarily in California and Washington state, our extensive production capabilities include structural and graphic design, value-added converting, flexographic printing, and lithographic lamination. Our advanced, environmentally sustainable packaging solutions serve a wide range of well-known customer brands across multiple industries including agriculture, food services, medical device, food products, wineries, high tech, pharma, cosmetics and many more!

**Why is Golden West Packaging Group THE place to work?**

We are a well-established, growing company in a stable industry that is re-imagining itself to be a place where everyone knows everyone, where you can make a difference, and where you can learn and grow professionally.

We are focused on safety and building an employee-centric work environment where team members can experience camaraderie, relevance, and career advancement.

As the packaging and logistics sector continues to grow, we’re growing with it and creating new opportunities. Come make your mark at a company that strives to celebrate your individuality, skills, and talents.

At Golden West Packaging Group, you’ll feel the difference and make a difference

**The Role You’ll Play**

The primary responsibility of the person in this position is to strategically grow sales and increase the Golden West (GW)’s profitability by developing, leading, and driving the GWPG sales strategy to identify and gain sales contracts that benefit the customer and advance Golden West profitable business growth strategies.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify and target new business opportunities through strategic prospecting, market research and networking
* Conduct sales presentations, pitches, and product demonstrations to showcase our packaging solutions
* Collaborate with other team members on the development of customized packaging products and service solutions to increase customer satisfaction and optimize GW’s sales profitability within a given product or market category.
* Generate new business opportunities in assigned categories to grow sales and increase Golden West’s market share
* Forecast sales projections, track performance metrics, and provide regular reports to management
* Stay current to market and customer trends and developments for given categories to identify new sales opportunities to expand existing customer sales volumes and new sales opportunities
* Ensure sales meet contributions margin requirements and ensure GW’s business sustainability
* Develop strategies to expand GW’s business and profitability
* Research competition and business climate for category to identify and mitigate risk of potential business threats and to optimize potential business opportunities
* Serve as the primary point of contact for existing customers, building strong relationships and understanding their needs
* Define business plans and strategies for assigned category to gain market share and maximize profitability and execute against such strategies to achieve plans

**What You’ll Get**

* A friendly, team-based, supportive work environment
* Competitive total compensation package
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, vision, dental, life insurance, and 401K plan with employer contribution
* Employee Assistance coverage with full services, including dietary and nutritional services, retirement planning and support services
* 10 paid holidays per year
* Paid time off
* Progressive employee referral program
* Professional development and career growth opportunities

If this sounds like you and if you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, we invite you to apply today!

**What You’ll Need**

**Required skills, knowledge and abilities:**

* Effective sales skills using a data-based, solution sales approach
* Proven track record of successful selling
* Strong organizational skills, discipline and attention to detail
* Customer focused mentality and approach to business
* Expert knowledge and understanding of industry packaging needs and solutions
* Strong verbal and written communications skills
* Proven analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong collaboration, interpersonal and relationship building skills

**Required education and experience:**

* B.S/A. in business administration or related field
* 5+ years of experience in sales and solutions sales with a proven track record of success
* Experience in packaging industry is desired

Golden West Packaging Group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.

Actual placement within range will be contingent upon several factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s qualifications, education, experience, internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Strategic Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Diodes Incorporated is seeking a Strategic Account Sales Manager responsible for new business development, revenue growth, and strategic account management within a select group of major accounts. The successful candidate will support customers in identifying products, solutions, and services that best meet their needs while driving demand creation, design wins, and long-term growth opportunities. This position serves as the primary interface between the customer and Diodes' Business Units (BUs), Field Applications Engineers (FAEs), Marketing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Executive Leadership teams.

**Principle Duties and Responsibility:**

* Build and manage Account Plans for each assigned account and territory, keeping the extended team of stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned to achieve growth objectives.
* Develop, communicate, and execute customer-specific account strategies based on compelling value propositions that drive new business opportunities and revenue growth.
* Own the design, deployment, and execution of winning account strategies to identify and capture every viable project, design opportunity, and revenue stream within assigned accounts.
* Drive demand creation activities by identifying customer roadmaps, projects, applications, and emerging technologies, aligning Diodes' product portfolio with customer requirements.
* Lead design-in and design-win activities across all Business Units to secure production business and increase market share.
* Develop and maintain an extensive knowledge base of assigned accounts, including business structure, technology roadmaps, key stakeholders, competitive landscape, purchasing processes, organizational dynamics, and strategic priorities.
* Collaborate closely with Business Unit Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, and FAEs to position products, develop technical solutions, and successfully close new design opportunities.
* Coordinate customer visits, technical reviews, executive meetings, and strategic planning sessions to strengthen customer relationships and uncover growth opportunities.
* Act as the primary escalation point for competitive, technical, quality, qualification, delivery, and commercial issues.
* Maintain accurate sales funnels, forecasts, opportunity pipelines, and account plans, providing visibility to Business Units and management on future revenue opportunities.
* Track and drive design wins from concept through production, ensuring alignment between customer requirements and internal execution.
* Communicate customer roadmaps, market trends, competitive intelligence, and emerging opportunities to Business Units to influence product development priorities and go-to-market strategies.
* Coordinate globally across sales organizations, Business Units, engineering teams, supply chain, and operations to facilitate alignment and strategic account execution.
* Conduct face-to-face customer management meetings as necessary to provide support, address issues, communicate updates, and build executive-level relationships.
* Negotiate and facilitate business matters including pricing, contracts, supply commitments, delivery schedules, and commercial agreements.
* Lead cross-functional teams consisting of Sales, FAEs, Product Marketing, Business Units, Quality, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and Global Operations to achieve account objectives and revenue targets.
* Operate effectively within a highly matrixed global organization while driving accountability and execution across multiple functional groups.
* Respect and comply with all Diodes personnel, sales, proposal, and contract policies, while operating within company travel and expense guidelines.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* 5+ years of sales experience in the semiconductor industry with strategic account management, key account management, and/or territory management responsibilities.
* Proven success managing large strategic customers and complex sales opportunities within OEM, Cloud, AI, Industrial, Consumer, Communications, Networking, Computing, or Automotive markets.
* Preferred BSEE or BS degree with relevant semiconductor, electronics, or technology industry experience.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand customer architectures, product requirements, design challenges, and competitive solutions.
* Demonstrated experience driving demand creation, design-in, and design-win activities resulting in measurable revenue growth.
* Thorough understanding of semiconductor market dynamics, customer buying behaviors, competitive positioning, and industry trends.
* Proven ability to influence and coordinate global cross-functional resources to remove barriers and achieve customer and revenue objectives.
* Strong forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, and opportunity management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills with customers at engineering, procurement, management, and executive levels.
* Proven ability to build trust-based relationships and influence decision-makers throughout customer organizations.
* Ability to identify customer roadmaps and translate future technology requirements into actionable business opportunities for Diodes.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail, responsiveness, follow-up discipline, and commitment to execution.
* Proven history of exceeding quota, achieving revenue targets, and delivering measurable business results in a fast-paced sales environment.
* Ability to effectively assess business opportunities, understand customer motivations, and develop winning sales strategies.
* Experience working successfully within a highly matrixed, multinational organization.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM-based opportunity management systems.

jobs.title: SharePoint Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
SharePoint Implementation and Microsoft 365 Solutions SpecialistProfessional Summary

Experienced SharePoint and Microsoft 365 professional with a strong focus on **end-to-end SharePoint implementation, solution design, workflow automation, and business process improvement**. Skilled in analyzing business requirements, designing scalable SharePoint solutions, implementing and configuring SharePoint sites and components, and integrating Microsoft 365 technologies to improve operational efficiency, information management, and cross-functional collaboration. Experienced in SharePoint Online administration, governance, permissions management, security, migration, modernization, and ongoing production support. Proven ability to collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, and technical partners to translate business needs into effective, secure, and sustainable technology solutions aligned with organizational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

* **SharePoint Implementation and Solution Delivery:** Lead and support end-to-end SharePoint implementations, including requirements gathering, solution architecture, site design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and post-implementation support.
* **SharePoint Site Design and Development:** Design, build, configure, and maintain SharePoint Online sites, site collections, document libraries, lists, metadata, content types, forms, web parts, navigation, and collaboration solutions tailored to business requirements.
* **Business Requirements and Analysis:** Partner with business stakeholders and subject matter experts to gather, analyze, validate, and document requirements, translating them into detailed functional specifications, technical designs, and implementation plans.
* **Workflow Automation:** Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain automated workflows using SharePoint, Power Automate, and related Microsoft 365 technologies to streamline approvals, notifications, document routing, task assignments, and business processes.
* **Business Process Optimization:** Evaluate existing business processes and SharePoint environments to identify inefficiencies, content management challenges, collaboration gaps, and automation opportunities; recommend and implement solutions that improve productivity and user experience.
* **SharePoint Governance and Security:** Establish and maintain SharePoint governance frameworks, standards, naming conventions, site provisioning procedures, lifecycle management practices, permission models, access controls, and external sharing policies in alignment with corporate security requirements.
* **SharePoint Environment Assessment:** Assess existing SharePoint environments, including site architecture, information structure, content organization, usage patterns, permissions, sharing configurations, and governance gaps; develop and execute recommendations for improvement.
* **Migration and Modernization:** Lead or participate in SharePoint migration, implementation, modernization, consolidation, and enhancement initiatives, supporting content migration, site restructuring, permissions validation, testing, and business continuity.
* **Microsoft 365 Integration and Administration:** Administer, configure, and support SharePoint Online and related Microsoft 365 services, including Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and Power Platform, to deliver integrated business solutions.
* **Documentation and Technical Specifications:** Develop and maintain functional and technical specifications, solution design documents, workflow diagrams, governance plans, implementation procedures, user guides, and operational documentation.
* **Testing and Deployment:** Perform functional testing, workflow validation, user acceptance testing coordination, issue resolution, deployment planning, and post-implementation validation to ensure SharePoint solutions meet business and technical requirements.
* **User Support and Troubleshooting:** Provide technical support, diagnose and resolve SharePoint and Microsoft 365 issues, manage access and permissions requests, and support ongoing maintenance and continuous improvement of implemented solutions.
* **Training and User Adoption:** Develop training materials, conduct demonstrations, and provide end-user guidance to promote adoption of SharePoint solutions, document management practices, automated workflows, and Microsoft 365 collaboration capabilities.
* **Stakeholder and Project Collaboration:** Serve as a liaison between business units, IT teams, project managers, vendors, and technical stakeholders to coordinate solution delivery, manage requirements, communicate implementation progress, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
* **Continuous Improvement and Technology Evaluation:** Monitor emerging SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform capabilities; evaluate new features and recommend enhancements that strengthen governance, security, automation, scalability, and collaboration.

Core Technical Competencies

* SharePoint Online implementation and administration
* SharePoint site architecture, configuration, and customization
* SharePoint lists, libraries, metadata, content types, and permissions
* Power Automate workflow development and business process automation
* Microsoft 365 integration and administration
* Microsoft Teams and OneDrive collaboration solutions
* SharePoint governance, security, and access management
* SharePoint migration, modernization, and environment assessments
* Requirements analysis and functional and technical specifications
* Testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support
* User training, technical documentation, and change management
* Business process improvement and stakeholder engagement

Pay: $60.00 - $85.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Schedule**: Monday to Friday (8am-4:30pm)

**Pay:** $25.50-$38.50

**ABOUT LIFEMOVES**

LifeMoves is the largest and most effective provider of housing and services for neighbors experiencing homelessness in Silicon Valley since 1987. Our Mission is to end homelessness by providing interim housing, supportive services, and building collaborative partnerships. With 40 programs , LifeMoves gives our neighbors experiencing homelessness a temporary place to call home while providing intensive, customized case management through site-based programs and community outreach.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

LifeMoves’ Homeless Outreach Teams (HOT) conduct outreach to unsheltered individuals experiencing homelessness. HOT collaborates with multiple internal and community organizations to provide holistic services to help the individuals return to stability. HOT is a subset of a larger Outreach team that includes Rapid Response Dispatch and an Encampment Resolution team.

The HOT Case Manager supports unsheltered individuals in accessing housing, healthcare, and other vital resources. Through direct outreach and intensive case management, they build trust, set client-centered goals, and provide flexible, trauma-informed support. Reporting to the Program Director, the CM meets clients where they are and helps guide them toward stability and self-sufficiency, while also engaging with the broader community through education and advocacy.

Key responsibilities include supporting clients by connecting them to services, building support networks, facilitating groups and activities, advocating for equitable access, and providing crisis intervention when needed. Beyond working directly with clients, this role may help to improve the overall program by sharing ideas, identifying service gaps, and helping strengthen community relationships. This role maintains clear documentation, contributes to program planning and reporting, and models professional, ethical behavior and works closely with their teammates to provide high-quality, coordinated care. Through their efforts, staff empower clients to grow their strengths, reach their goals, and build a better future.

**ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client Support and Case Management**

* Develop, implement, and revise individual case plans with housing/employment/benefit/health and well being tasks based on client strengths and goals.
* Support clients with tasks including but not limited to housing searches, employment preparation, benefits access, life skills development, build resumes, cover letters, and navigate employment and housing resources.
* Support clients with enrollment into benefit programs including but not limited to General Assistance, CalFresh, and Cash Assistance Program for Immigrants.
* Coordinate with health care access to understand and support client physical and behavioral health needs. Assist clients by scheduling medical appointments, arranging transportation, and accompanying them to appointments as needed.
* Facilitate client-centered groups, workshops, or education sessions to build skills and confidence.

**Resource Connection and Community Collaboration**

* Serve as a liaison between LifeMoves and community partners by building strong relationships, connecting clients to needed resources and services, and educating the community on client needs and trauma-informed care.
* Coordinate with relevant public partners, for example probation officers, Veterans Affairs, Adult Protective Services (APS), Child Protective Services (CPS) and city, state, and federal agencies, to support client needs and program goals.

**Client Advocacy, Mediation, and Conflict Resolution**

* Serve as a liaison between clients and landlords, employers, or agencies to support successful outcomes. Provide mediation and conflict resolution support as needed.
* Advocate for client rights and reduce stigma around homelessness and mental health challenges. Advocate for clients' needs and strengths when working with partners, landlords, employers, and other agencies.

**Data Tracking and Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, case notes, reports, and program data in line with agency standards and confidentiality laws utilizing Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) and the LifeMoves internal client management system
* Track client progress, program outcomes, housing placements, employment and learning successes, and community partnerships.

**Crisis Management and Safety**

* Provide crisis intervention and make referrals to appropriate services when needed.

**General Agency Responsibilities**

* Participate in weekly case conferences, monthly trainings, and regular supervision to strengthen skills.
* Fully participate in all required trainings. This includes completing trainings by assigned deadlines, actively engaging during sessions, and applying what you learn to your daily work.

  + Training expectations in the first 90 days of employment include but are not limited to CPR, Mental Health/First Aid (MHFA), Nonviolent Crisis Intervention Training, HMIS and internal database training.
  + Additional required trainings through our online Learning Management System Relias include but are not limited to Client's Experience of Trauma-Informed Care, Working with Individuals Experiencing Homelessness, Overview of Serious Mental Illness for Paraprofessionals, Working with Individuals Experiencing Homelessness and Substance Use Disorder, An Overview of Substance Use Disorders, Strategies for Preventing and De-escalating Hostile Situations, Recognizing and Responding to a Person in Crisis, Maintaining Professional Boundaries, Overcoming Barriers to LGBTQ+ Affirming Behavioral Health Services, Privacy and Confidentiality for Non-HIPAA Covered Entities, Child/Elder/Dependent Abuse Prevention and Mandated Reporting, Preventing, Identifying, and Responding to Abuse and Neglect, Reporting Elder and Dependent Adult Abuse in California, Iden

Consumer-Centricity & Complaints Management

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Sales Operations Manager**

**THE ALBA GROUP** | Commercial | Houston, TX

**Title**

Sales Operations Manager

  

**Company**

Alba Wheels Up International (the Alba Group)

  

**Reports to**

Alexandra Kleinschmidt, EVP Commercial

  

**Location**

Houston, TX (confirm onsite, hybrid or remote)

  

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

  

**Scope**

Commercial operations across all five Alba Group brands

  

**Systems**

HubSpot, Revenue Vessel, Clarity / Power BI (reporting), advanced Excel, AI tools. CargoWise and netCHB a plus.

**ABOUT THE ALBA GROUP**

The Alba Group is a national customs brokerage, freight forwarding and trade compliance platform backed by Southfield Capital. We operate five brands: Alba, Advance Customs Brokers International (ACB), John A. Steer Company, The Perishable Specialist (PSI) and Cobalt Wine Logistics.

Our clients are importers in perishables and fresh produce, retail and apparel, wine and spirits, and semiconductors and electronics. We win on expertise and value-add solutions, not on rates. We are building one commercial engine across all five brands, and this role sits at its center.

**THE ROLE**

The Sales Operations Manager owns the commercial data, process and coordination behind the Alba Group's sales and account management teams. You make sure our CRM data is right, our sellers walk into client conversations with real importer insight, and our internal meetings happen on time with the right people in the room.

You work alongside our sales support coordinator, who handles day-to-day CRM updates. You own the standards, the processes and the analysis. You partner daily with the EVP Commercial, sales, account management, trade advisory, pricing, operations and implementation.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**CRM data management**

* Own the integrity of commercial data in HubSpot across all five brands: accounts, contacts, opportunities and activity.
* Set data standards and guide the sales support coordinator on day-to-day updates so records stay clean and complete.
* Audit data regularly, fix gaps and duplicates, and keep HubSpot aligned with Revenue Vessel.
* Run a weekly pipeline hygiene check for stale deals, missing next steps and past-due close dates, and send each seller their list.

**HubSpot dashboards and reporting**

* Build and maintain HubSpot dashboards and reports for sales, account management and leadership.
* Pull and interpret revenue reporting from Clarity / Power BI to support commercial reviews.

**Importer analysis and prospecting**

* Analyze importer activity using trade data and importer intelligence tools: volumes, ports, origins, commodities, current brokers and forwarders.
* Use advanced Excel and AI tools to work through large importer data sets quickly.
* Turn that analysis into clear inputs so sales and account management can build targeted client proposals.
* Build target prospect lists by vertical for the sellers and the LATAM SDR using importer data.
* Support prospect research and account planning with data on where each client or prospect is growing.

**Account management reporting**

* Run regular reports for account management to identify downtrending accounts as early as possible.
* Flag shifts in shipment volume, NR and activity so account managers can act before an account is lost.
* Pull shipment, spend and trend data for key-account quarterly business reviews (QBRs). Account managers remain responsible for building and presenting their QBR.
* Track account tiering, assignments and portfolio NR targets in the account management program.

**Proposal and RFP coordination**

* Own the proposal and RFP calendar so deadlines are visible and nothing is rushed.
* Gather inputs from pricing, freight forwarding, customs brokerage and trade advisory, and route them to the proposal owner on time.
* Maintain a library of approved proposal templates, service descriptions and client case studies.

**Process ownership**

* Help design, document and roll out commercial processes, from lead to quote to onboarding handoff.
* Keep process documents, playbooks and templates current as the business changes.
* Partner with pricing and implementation so handoffs are clean and nothing falls through the cracks.

**Internal meeting coordination**

* Serve as the internal connector between sales and the other groups: operations, trade advisory, pricing and implementation.
* Organize and schedule client prep meetings, internal reviews and pipeline calls well in advance, so nothing is last minute.
* Set agendas, confirm attendees and materials, and track follow-ups to completion.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Required**

* 5+ years in sales operations, revenue operations or commercial analytics in a B2B environment.
* Hands-on HubSpot experience, including building dashboards and reports and managing data quality.
* Experience with Revenue Vessel and with pulling reports from Clarity / Power BI.
* Strong analytical skills with data management and trade data tools.
* Advanced Excel: pivot tables, lookups, Power Query and building models from raw data.
* Proficient with AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT or Claude to speed up analysis, reporting and documentation.
* Highly organized. Comfortable coordinating meetings and calendars across several teams and senior leaders.
* Clear, concise communicator who can turn data into a story sales can use.
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, analytics or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred**

* Background in logistics, freight forwarding, customs brokerage or trade compliance.
* Experience with importer data and trade intelligence platforms.
* CargoWise and netCHB experience.
* Experience running account health or churn reporting.
* Spanish proficiency.

**HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED**

* Data quality: share of HubSpot records meeting data standards.
* Early warning: downtrending accounts flagged before NR loss compounds.
* Proposal support: importer analysis and proposal inputs delivered

jobs.title: Product Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**OUR MISSION**
---------------

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. That only happens when the people using our tools understand them, trust them, and have a clear path to get help when something isn't working. Strong product operations is how we close the gap between what we build and how it's used every day.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

We're hiring a Product Operations Lead to make sure the software we build works well for the people who use it, from the day a feature ships and every day after. Thyme Care runs on three software platforms. The largest, Thyme Box, is the care management platform where our nurses, social workers, care partners, nurse practitioners, and medical directors spend their day. You'll connect our product and engineering teams with the care team: you'll know how our products work in practice, spot problems early, and make sure changes land smoothly.

The work is broad. It covers first-line triage and user support, rollout planning, training and documentation, usage monitoring, and the operating rhythm of the product organization. Many of these processes exist informally today, and you'll have room to formalize and improve them. You'll partner closely with product managers, engineering, quality engineering, data science, service design, our training team, and Care Delivery and Enrollment operations.

Additionally, you will:

* **Become the expert on how our products work:** learn all three of our platforms and the key data assets behind them in depth, give introductory demos to new team members across tech and the broader company, and be a go-to resource when someone needs to understand how something works
* **Serve as first-line triage for Thyme Box issues:** partner with Quality Engineering on bug triage, field reports from the care team, ask the clarifying questions that separate "the product works differently than I expected" from "something is broken," and hand off well-documented issues for technical investigation
* **Run product rollouts:** partner with PMs and engineering to plan and project manage feature pilots and rollouts with Care Delivery and Enrollment operations, provide first-line support to end users as changes go live, and own release notes and cross-functional communications and training materials for upcoming releases
* **Support quality before launch:** help QA new features across engineering and service design pods, and set up in-product walkthroughs and tooltips for new functionality
* **Keep training and documentation accurate:** own the accuracy of Thyme Box training documentation and reference materials; partner with our training team on new hire onboarding and refresher materials for the care team; and review other training materials and process changes for how they interact with Thyme Box, recommending ways to streamline those processes in the tool
* **Monitor usage and listen to users:** use tools and data analysis to spot unusual Thyme Box usage patterns and flag them to the right teams, and run regular user satisfaction surveys, turning results into clear findings that product teams can act on
* **Keep product teams close to the care team:** coordinate regular shadowing sessions so product, engineering, and data science see their users' work firsthand, and create documents, videos, and other materials that explain to the care team how our tech teams work and how they can contribute
* **Run the product org's operating rhythm:** maintain a current product roadmap deck across all pods by gathering inputs from each PM, and own the product process calendar, including quarterly roadmap planning, vendor renewals, tech debt days, hackathons, and other recurring milestones
* **Use AI to work more efficiently:** apply AI tools to drafting documentation, analyzing survey and usage data, and building training materials

**WHAT YOU'VE DONE**

* Healthcare experience, especially in care delivery, digital health, or value-based care
* Experience acting as the bridge between end users and technical teams, including triaging issues and writing clear, reproducible bug reports
* Track record of planning and running software rollouts, including training, communications, and user support through launch
* Experience creating training materials, documentation, or user guides that people actually use and that drive successful feature adoption
* Comfort working with data: you can use monitoring or analytics tools, pull together usage data, and explain what you're seeing to non-technical audiences
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to keep many recurring processes and deadlines on track at once

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

The Implementation team at Vividly plays a critical role in turning a customer's solution design into a successful, operational Vividly experience.

Our Implementation Managers are both **hands-on platform configurators and end-to-end project managers**. They take an approved solution design and translate it into Vividly configuration, customer workflows, data setup, training, testing, and ultimately go-live.

Implementation Managers serve as the primary point of contact throughout onboarding, coordinating across customers, Solution Architecture, Integrations, Managed Services, Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to keep complex projects moving forward.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, understanding complex workflows, configuring software, managing multiple moving pieces, and creating an onboarding experience that gives customers confidence they made the right investment.

**Who You Are**

You are an energetic, curious, and highly accountable implementation professional who enjoys being in front of customers as much as you enjoy getting into the details of how a platform should be configured.

You're comfortable taking an approved solution design, understanding the business intent behind it, and turning it into something real. You can work through complex business workflows, translate requirements into accurate platform configuration, work confidently with customer data, and explain how the resulting experience will work for the people using it.

You're also a strong project manager. You can manage multiple implementations at once, keep customers and internal teams accountable, identify dependencies before they become blockers, and create momentum without sacrificing quality.

You don't need to design every solution from scratch, but you do need to understand the solution you're implementing. You ask questions when something doesn't make sense, recognize when customer requirements have materially changed, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and know when to bring Solution Architecture back into the conversation before changes create unnecessary complexity, scope creep, or rework.

Most importantly, you bring energy to the customer experience. You're engaged, passionate about helping customers succeed, comfortable leading a room, and genuinely enjoy seeing customers move from complicated processes to confidently operating in Vividly.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the end-to-end implementation project for assigned customers, from post-Solution Alignment through configuration, training, UAT, go-live, and transition.
* Serve as the primary project manager and day-to-day customer lead throughout onboarding, owning timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, customer actions, and overall project health.
* Translate approved Solution Architecture designs into accurate, scalable Vividly platform configuration.
* Configure customer workflows, master data, promotion structures, deduction-related settings, reporting requirements, user access, and other applicable platform components based on the approved solution.
* Understand the business purpose behind the configuration, not simply the individual fields or settings being configured.
* Prepare, transform, import, map, and validate customer datasets, including customer, product, pricing, revenue, and other applicable data.
* Validate configured workflows against the approved solution design and expected customer experience before progressing into training, UAT, and go-live.
* Lead customer implementation meetings with confidence, clear direction, and strong follow-through.
* Hold customers and internal stakeholders accountable to agreed actions, decisions, and timelines.
* Proactively identify risks, blockers, dependencies, and decisions that could impact scope, timeline, or customer readiness and drive them toward resolution.
* Coordinate cross-functional onboarding workstreams, including Integrations and Managed Services, while maintaining visibility into dependencies that impact the overall implementation.
* Deliver initial platform and workflow training to establish customer operational readiness and prepare users to begin successfully working in Vividly.
* Guide customers through UAT and confirm that configured workflows operate as intended before go-live.
* Assess customer readiness across configuration, data, training, integrations, services dependencies, and outstanding customer actions.
* Complete structured handoffs to Customer Success and Managed Services, ensuring important customer context, business outcomes, decisions, risks, and outstanding actions carry forward after implementation.
* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues, identify root causes, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams when additional expertise is required.

jobs.title: Project Manager I, SPN
jobs.description:
**ABOUT STORD**
---------------

  

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

  

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

  

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

  

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About the Role:
  
As a Program Manager, Professional Services, you will be the face of Stord as we grow our business and partnerships together with our customers. You will be responsible for driving the onboarding experience of new customers to Stord's supply chain solutions, as well as enabling the brand growth of existing customers as they launch new channels, services, and products to their end-customers.

**What You'll Do:**

* Maintain and successfully execute a portfolio of customer projects ranging from fulfillment onboarding to standalone (SW-only) WMS & OMS launches to Professional Services engagements; and gracefully and seamlessly adjust to rapidly changing priorities in that portfolio
* Partner with Commercial, Implementation, Integration, and Operations team members to drive and own all aspects of Stord’s onboarding process from signature through hypercare, including systems, infrastructure, SOPs/training, testing, launch, post-deployment feedback, and translating customer enhancement requests to requirements and SOPs
* Balance a number of internal and external priorities (i.e. customer business outcomes, resource limitations, tight timelines, evolving scope changes, milestone risks and project budget constraints) with discretion and thoughtfulness towards both customer and Stord goals
* Track progress and performance in customer onboarding process (meeting timelines/scope commitments, delivering revenue), including identifying and implementing new KPIs and metrics to measure and improve our existing processes
* Spearhead the design and execution of innovative technology solutions and implementation of new systems/processes for existing customers across our supply chain network, such as the deployment of new internal tools for employee use, or migrating customers from legacy systems to Stord software
* Provide feedback to refine, develop and evolve Stord’s service offering, solution design process, and onboarding process and experience for new customers
* Act as a culture warrior for Stord values, as well as an advocate for continuous improvement, by identifying opportunities and efficiencies in Supply Chain and across the organization

**What You'll Need:**

* Excellent communication skills (verbal, written), to communicate horizontally and vertically within the organization and externally to customer stakeholders, all with clarity, precision and succinctness
* Willingness to be a versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure, bold in asking for clarification when the requirement or action item is unclear, and unafraid to challenge assumptions or expectations that are unfounded
* The endless drive and resilience to remove barriers and enable teams to complete their objectives, and the charisma to lead and bring together members from functional, technical and operational to achieve program goals
* Experience in a cross-functional, customer-oriented change role such as a consultant, manager, or customer implementation manager in a supply chain services, SaaS, and/or consulting environment
* Demonstrated ability to deliver results in a complex, fast-paced environment while balancing multiple priorities, mitigating risks, and effectively managing limited resources
* Enthusiastic desire to continuously iterate and improve existing tools and processes, with customer obsession and successful business outcomes as core drivers
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% for customer-critical milestones such as kickoffs and go-lives; building strong customer relationships and leveraging effective partnership across local & remote Stord teams will be critical to your success in this role

**Strongly Encouraged:**

* Supply Chain or Logistics experience – in particular in implementing WMS, OMS, SaaS and/or fulfillment solutions
* Functional and/or technical solution design experience
* Transformation experience – including business process change management and experience sunsetting legacy systems

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Specialist - Procurement Solutions
jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is seeking an experienced Senior Implementation Specialist to lead client implementations of Procurement Solutions, which includes CostCheck, ShortageCheck and 340BCheck. CostCheck, our pharmacy purchasing and cost-savings optimization solution. CostCheck helps hospitals maximize pharmacy savings opportunities by monitoring spend against savings caps, GPO contract terms, and 340B program requirements. ShortageCheck predicts hospital and pharmacy drug shortages up to 90 days in advance, using market-wide signals — fulfillment delays, demand surges, usage trends — from over 3,250 healthcare organizations to give your team the lead time to plan ahead instead of scrambling once patient care is at risk. 340BCheck340BCheck unifies 340B data in one compliance command center, built on real HRSA audit requirements, so hospitals and grantees stay continuously audit-ready as their program grows. This is a senior role on the Implementation team, suited to someone who has already worked in hospital pharmacy purchasing or cost-savings optimization, and can bring that domain depth directly into how our customers configure and adopt Procurement solutions.

As a senior member of the team, this person will manage the most complex implementations — configuring systems to maximize potentials and fill gaps , and setting customers up on sound methodology from day one — act as a trusted advisor to customers' purchasing and pharmacy leadership, and help mentor other Implementation Specialists on purchasing-, supply- and cost-related workflows.

The ideal candidate is highly attentive to detail, comfortable talking with pharmacy buyers, purchasing directors, and finance stakeholders, and can operate in an environment that is often ambiguous and requires creativity to resolve issues.

### **Representative Duties & Responsibilities**

* Manage all aspects of Procurement Solution implementation projects, including project kick-off, software and pricing/contract configuration, go-live, and training, while maintaining project timelines.
* Configure and validate data, system outcomes, workflows, , and wholesaler/purchasing data feeds so customers' performance is tracked accurately from go-live.
* Act as the main point of contact for customers before they go live, owning all communications including weekly check-in meetings, ad hoc calls, and emails.
* Manage multiple implementation projects at once, across customers with different priorities, purchasing structures, and deadlines.

jobs.title: Patient Access Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.  
  
We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.  
  
At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

**About the job**

The Patient Access Coordinator is Vynca's front line — often the first voice a patient, family member, provider, or health plan hears. This role owns every inbound call and, separately, owns direct referrals end to end (from providers, hospitals, facilities, and community partners) through intake and prep, then hands the fully prepped referral to EMA for direct outreach. MIF list referrals are out of scope for this role. The ideal candidate is warm and calm under pressure, catches clinical red flags, and keeps calls and referrals moving without anything falling through the cracks.  
  
*At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states with a strong preference for those EST based: California, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington.*

**What you'll do**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound calls, meeting call answer rate and service level targets, and flagging volume or staffing risks to the Shared Services Manager.
* Assess each caller's need and route or warm-transfer to the right department the first time; identify clinical trigger words and escalate to triage immediately per protocol.
* De-escalate distressed or upset callers, and know when to involve a supervisor or clinician.
* Own direct referrals end to end (providers, hospitals, facilities, community partners); MIF list referrals are out of scope.
* Complete intake for each direct referral — pre-admission assessment, scheduling support, and documentation — then hand off the fully prepped referral to EMA for direct outreach.
* Document call and intake details accurately in real time; maintain databases, logs, census sheets, and contact lists.
* Manage voicemails, callback queues, and after-hours messages within established timeframes.
* Meet call handling and referral prep targets; follow scripts and quality standards; participate in coaching, team meetings, and huddles.
* Maintain strict HIPAA compliance, and perform other duties as assigned.

**Your experience and qualifications**

* Associate degree or medical/business office training highly preferred.
* 2+ years in a high call volume role (i.e call center, medical front office, patient access, and/or or intake/admissions).
* Healthcare experience required. *Experience in palliative care, home health, hospice, discharge planning, or safety-net hospital settings, highly preferred.*
* Proven de-escalation skills with distressed or grieving callers, and the judgment to know what to escalate.
* Ability to recognize clinical trigger words after training (no license required); clinical fluency from training or experience alongside SWs, RNs, MAs, chaplains, or scribes a plus.
* Strong multitasker across phone, documentation, and multiple systems; reliable attendance; comfortable with Google Workspace, Salesforce, telephony, and EHR systems.
* Cultural competency and working knowledge of HIPAA, with the ability to manage difficult conversations involving serious illness, grief, and/or end of life care.
* Willing and able to work Monday-Friday 8:30-5pm EST with occasional evenings/weekends.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) required.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* The hiring process for this role may consist of applying, followed by a phone screen, online assessment(s), interview(s), an offer, and background/reference checks.
* Background Screening: A background check, which may include a drug test or other health screenings depending on the role, will be required prior to employment.

* Vaccination Requirement: Employees in patient, client, or customer-facing roles must be vaccinated against influenza. Requests for religious or medical accommodations will be considered but may not always be approved.
* Employment Eligibility: Compliance with federal law requires identity and work eligibility verification using E-Verify upon hire.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: At Vynca Inc., we embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We value all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other protected group under federal, state, or local law.

  + Regularly requires working at a computer for an entire shift (with appropriate breaks).

**Position Summary**

SHR Consulting Group is seeking a detail-oriented **Quality Manager** to manage and support the company’s quality, compliance, and continuous improvement programs. This position is responsible for maintaining controlled company documentation, supporting compliance with **ISO and CMMI** standards, and serving as the primary owner responsible and accountable for company certification, surveillance, internal, and external audit activities.

The Quality Manager will lead audit preparation and coordination, ensure required evidence and documentation are maintained, facilitate audit activities, track findings and corrective actions, and maintain year-round audit readiness. The ideal candidate has strong experience with document control, quality management systems, ISO certifications and audits, and CMMI requirements and is comfortable taking ownership of compliance activities from preparation through successful completion. Candidates with experience supporting a government contracting organization in a similar role and who reside in the DC Metro Area are highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Audit Ownership & Accountability**

* Serve as the primary point of accountability for SHR’s ISO, CMMI, and applicable quality/compliance audits and assessments.
* Own the audit lifecycle from planning and preparation through audit completion, corrective actions, and closure.
* Develop and maintain annual audit schedules and readiness plans for certification, recertification, surveillance, internal, and other applicable audits.
* Coordinate directly with auditors, assessors, certification bodies, internal process owners, and other stakeholders throughout the audit process.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!

**About Picus**

Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. This individual will play a key role in maintaining overall client health, driving platform adoption, supporting strategic initiatives, and ensuring clients maximize the value of iCapital's solutions through proactive engagement, training, and ongoing relationship management. **Qualifications**
